description.en: Desktop notifications, sounds and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; toggleable in Settings with zh/en notification language.
description.zh: 模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹出系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；可在设置页开关并切换通知语言。
